cards.text: Israel's tribes are receiving their land, and Judah and the sons of Joseph, Ephraim and Manasseh, already have theirs (Joshua 15:1; 16:4). Now the whole congregation of Israel gathers in one place and sets up the Tent of Meeting there. EVERYBODY, in one spot, and I panic when two bakers walk in at the same time.

cards.question: The whole congregation of Israel gathers at ___ and sets up the Tent of Meeting there.

cards.text: The land is subdued before them, so the job's done, right? Not so fast, friend.

cards.question: The land is subdued before Israel, so what's still unfinished?

answers.text: Seven tribes haven't received their inheritance
The Tent of Meeting has no priest

cards.text: So Joshua, Israel's leader, has a question for the Israelites.

cards.question: With seven tribes still waiting on their land, Joshua asks the Israelites why they're in such a hurry.

cards.text: Joshua asks how long they'll put off taking the land the LORD, the God of their fathers, has given them. They're hitting the snooze button on a GIFT, friend.

cards.question: Joshua lays out a plan: the Israelites appoint ___ men from each tribe.
What will Joshua send these men from each tribe out to do?

answers.text: Survey the land and map it out
Drive the Canaanites out of it
Build an altar in every region

cards.text: Joshua also says Judah stays in its territory in the south, and the house of Joseph stays in theirs in the north.

cards.question: Once the seven portions are mapped out and brought to Joshua, how will he decide which tribe gets which?

answers.text: Give the biggest tribe first pick

cards.text: And there's more. Joshua says the Levites, the tribe that serves at the Tent of Meeting (Numbers 3:7), have no portion among them.

cards.question: The Levites have no portion of land, because their inheritance is the ___ of the LORD.
Gad, Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh aren't in this drawing either, because Moses, Israel's leader before Joshua, already gave them land beyond the Jordan to the east.

cards.text: As the men get up to go, Joshua tells them again to survey the land, map it out and come back, so he can cast lots for them here in Shiloh before the LORD. Friend, that's exactly how I explain a recipe: twice, and then once more while you're already mixing.
So off they go, all through the land, mapping it city by city into seven portions.

cards.question: When the men come back to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh, what do they bring with them?

answers.text: A count of every fighting man

cards.text: Then Joshua casts lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh and hands out the land. Friend, I haven't held my breath like this since my junk drawer days, when every time that drawer slid open, we all waited to see who'd get picked.

Then the lots come out one by one for Benjamin, Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and Dan, each with its land, its cities and their villages. Benjamin's cities include Jebus, that is, Jerusalem, and Simeon's land sits inside Judah's, because the share for Judah's descendants was too large for them. Yes, friend. THAT Jerusalem.
Once the land is all divided, the Israelites still have one more inheritance to give.

cards.question: When all the land is divided, the Israelites give one more inheritance to someone among them. Who?
The Israelites give Joshua his inheritance on their own, without any command from the LORD.
The Israelites give Joshua the city of Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. How does it end up being that city?

answers.text: It was the last city left

cards.question: Joshua ___ the city of Timnath-serah and settles in it.
Eleazar the priest, Joshua and the heads of the families hand out these inheritances to the tribes of Israel by lot at Shiloh, before the LORD.

cards.text: So they finish dividing up the land at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. Seven tribes waiting, seven lots cast, and the job is DONE. Friend, I've been almost done with one cookie box since my timer was new.
